correctness.rationale: Write x=au,y=bv with unit u perpendicular_B v and s=(a/b)^2. The ratio is sqrt(s)||u-v||/||su-v||; Birkhoff orthogonality gives denominator>=s. For s<=1, triangle bounds combined with ||su-v||>=|s-1| and s yield <=sqrt2. For s>=1, triangle bound yields <=(2s-1)/s^(3/2), and exact polynomial (2s-3)^2(8s-3)>=0 gives <=4sqrt6/9<sqrt2. The l_infty² vectors u=(1,1),v=(1,0),s=1/2 attain sqrt2. Independent symbolic factorization and numerical witness rechecked.
